reason: Manually viewed unchanged primary, complete raw master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Approved: retains bare/receding crown with sparse grey/brown side and actual brow hair, clean upper lip/chin, understated closed expression and original mild head angle/roll. Dark NAVY OPEN suit, pale white/grey shirt collar and navy tie with pale diagonal striping remain. Compact rounded head meets a short broad raised shirt neckline, without separate yellow shaft, pointed V funnel, narrow pinching, floating collar or cream bib. Actual light grey/cream backing, complete tilted frame and cream-note overlap are retained. Whole raw white/cyan/alpha panels show opaque interior skin, hair, suit, collar/tie, frame, backing and note, with transparency only outside card silhouette. No cap, spectacles or new insignia introduced. Fine tie stripe geometry is not claimed pixel-exact at source size. No in-game claim.
